boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Miami University-Oxford
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with late availability documented on their direct business pages.

cards.title: Bruno's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 31 E High St · open until 3 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the Uptown address for a late carryout or dine-in meal; check the restaurant’s page before leaving because weekly hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A High Street pizza and sandwich stop with 3 a.m. hours on most late-week nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Bruno's lists Oxford hours until 3 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Tuesday–Friday 4 p.m.–3 a.m., Saturday noon–3 a.m., and Sunday noon–10 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Doughby's
cards.subtitle: 36 W High St · open until 3 a.m. Monday–Saturday
cards.notes: Head to the West High Street shop for calzones or crepes, and use the posted schedule to choose a night when the 3 a.m. closing applies.
cards.short_summary: A named Uptown calzone-and-crepe shop with late daily service.
cards.evidence_claim: Doughby's posts 4 p.m.–3 a.m. hours Monday through Saturday and 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Sunday hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 4 p.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 4 p.m.–2 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 431 S Locust St · currently listed until 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery through the Oxford location page, then confirm its live closing time shown at the top before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A South Locust carryout-and-delivery option with a location-specific late listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's Oxford location page currently states that the store is open until 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza — 431 South Locust St, Oxford
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently displays “Today Until 3:00 AM”; it directs customers to the page for up-to-date store hours.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza
cards.subtitle: 619 S Locust St · carryout until 1:10 a.m. Friday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the Oxford store’s official ordering page for carryout or delivery, selecting Friday or Saturday for its latest posted pickup window.
cards.short_summary: A South Locust pizza option whose official page separates carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists Friday and Saturday carryout until 1:10 a.m. and delivery until 1:30 a.m. at its Oxford store.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns — 619 S Locust St, Oxford
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday–Saturday carryout 10 a.m.–1:10 a.m. and delivery 10 a.m.–1:30 a.m.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: 601 Locust St · open 24 hours
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm service availability, then choose the lobby, drive-thru, or listed ordering option that suits your trip.
cards.short_summary: A Locust Street restaurant whose official listing shows round-the-clock lobby and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists its 601 Locust Street Oxford restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists restaurant/lobby and drive-thru hours as 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Bagel & Deli Shop
cards.subtitle: 119 E High St · open after bars close on most in-session nights
cards.notes: Check the shop’s ordering and hours page before walking over; its official site says late availability varies with Miami’s session schedule.
cards.short_summary: An East High Street bagel-and-sub shop with explicitly late service during the academic session.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel & Deli says it opens at 8 a.m. most days and stays open until after bars close most nights that Miami is in session.
cards.access_notes: Official site describes late service “most nights that Miami is in session”; verify the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Cocina Latina
cards.subtitle: 24 E Park Pl · open until midnight Friday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the location’s official ordering page for pickup or delivery and plan for Friday or Saturday when its posted hours extend to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Park Place restaurant with midnight weekend hours on its Oxford location page.
cards.evidence_claim: Cocina Latina's Oxford location lists Friday and Saturday hours from 10 a.m. until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday 10 a.m.–12 a.m.; it notes that hours may vary by location.

cards.title: Bello Wood Fired Pizza
cards.subtitle: 31 W High St · pizza oven open until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday visit around the wood-fired oven’s posted 10 p.m. cutoff, and check the business site for holiday closures.
cards.short_summary: A West High Street pizza studio with an explicitly posted late-week oven time.
cards.evidence_claim: Bello lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m. and says its pizza oven is open until 10 p.m. those nights.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday 4:30–11 p.m.; the pizza oven is stated to be open until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Fridge & Pantry
cards.subtitle: 35 E Church St · open until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the downtown market for deli or café pickup before its posted closing time, and call ahead on holidays as the business advises.
cards.short_summary: A Church Street deli, café, and market with 10 p.m. service most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Fridge & Pantry lists Monday–Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m. at 35 E Church Street.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Saturday 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; it advises calling ahead for holiday hours.

cards.title: Fiesta Charra
cards.subtitle: 25 W High St · open until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s Oxford ordering page to choose a Friday or Saturday pickup or delivery order before the posted 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A West High Street Mexican restaurant with late-week 11 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fiesta Charra's Oxford location lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering location page lists Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–11 p.m. and notes that hours may vary by location.
